text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, Jan 21 - Bombay - no labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 16 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 4 vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 21 waiting to discharge, 1 vessel bunkering, 1 under repairs, 1 awaiting orders. Berthing delays - container vessels - 1-2 days, bulkers - 12-15 days, general cargo vessels - 2-3 days.

Calcutta - seven vessels loading at berth, 19 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 2 vessels bunkering, 15 vessels due (2 coking coal, 5 products tankers, 5 containers, 1 crude, 1 lead concentrate, 1 rock phosphate).

Cochin - no labour problems. One vessel loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 2 vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 waiting to discharge, 1 oil tanker dry-docked, 1 vessel at shipyard jetty for repairs,fitting, 7 vessels due with up to 1 days delay expected.

Chennai (Madras) - no labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 4 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge, 34 vessels due (7 general cargo, 3 edible oil, 7 coal, 10 containers, 1 panamax, 1 scrap, 1 chemicals, 2 ore, 1 steel, 1 other vessel) with following delays expected - coal,coke - 3-4 days, scrap - 4-5 days, no delays for containers/iron ore/ fertiliser/others - 2-3 days.

Mormugao - no labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 1 loading at anchorage, 1 discharging at berth, 2 vessels waiting to load, 3 vessels under repairs/dry-docked, 2 awaiting orders, 12 vessels due (9 ore, 1 containers, 1 HSD, 1 naphtha) with following delays expected - ore - 4-5 days, no delays for naphtha/HSD/containers.

Kandla - seven vessels loading at berth, 2 dischargingt berth, 4 vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge, 3 tankers at jetty, 13 vessels waiting, 16 vessels due with 6-7 days delay expected.

Mangalore - no labour problems. Two vessels loading/discharging at berth, 4 vessels awaiting berths, 1 vessel under arrest, 5 vessels due with up to 1 days delay expected. Jawaharlal Nehru - no labour problems. Fire damage - one string of the conveyor system is expected to be available for discharging food grain by the end of Jan. One vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth (fertiliser/raw material), 5 vessels due (2 fertiliser/raw materials, 3 tankers/iron ore) with following delays expected - fertiliser/raw materials - 8-10 days, no delays for tankers/iron ore vessels.

Paradip - no labour problems. One vessel discharging at berth, 1 vessel waiting at anchor to load, 2 waiting to discharge, 7 vessels due (2 coal, 1 iron ore, 2 oil, 2 chemicals/gas) with up to 1 days delay expected.
Tuticorin - no labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 1 vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge, 4 vessels due with no delays expected.

Visakhapatnam - no labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth, 18 vessels due of which 8 exporters (1 steel cargoes/granite blocks, 1 steel billets, 1 wire coils, 1 steel plates, 1 tin, 1 aluminium ingots, 1 granite blocks - all with 7-8 days delay expected, 1 thermal coal with up to 1 days delay expected), 10 importers (1 urea - 2-3 days delay expected, 1 coking coal, 2 general cargo, 1 sunflower oil - all with 3-4 days delay expected, 1 iron ore, 1 clinker - both with 7-8 days delay expected, 1 containers, 1 liquid ammonia, 1 caustic soda - all with up to 1 days delay expected.)

MALAYSIA, Jan 22 - Port Kelang - North/south port - Containers, ro-ro berth - 8 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 1 days waiting time expected. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels berthed, 2 berthing 22/1. 6 Vessels waiting with 2 days waiting time expected. Dry,cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 2 days waiting time expected. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels berthed, 2 vessels waiting with 1 days waiting time expected. West port - Container, ro-ro berth - 2 Vessels berthed, none waiting, no delays. Deep draft conventional wharf - 6 Vessels berthed, 8 waiting with 2 days waiting time expected. Cement bulk terminal - 3 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 2 days wait

MAURITIUS, Jan 21 - Port Louis - Port labour working normally. Three vessels in port of which 1 discharging/loading containers, 1 discharging general cargo, 9 fishing vessels at fishing port for bunkering /discharging etc. No idle vessels, 1 dry-docked.

PAKISTAN , Jan 20 - karachi - five rice vessels loading at berth, 3 container vessels loading/discharging at berth/ 8 vessels discharging at berth (sugar, urea, general cargo, urea, dap, hsd)/ 17 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (general cargo, containers, phosphate, fertiliser, sugar, gas, oil)/ 2 vessels awaiting orders, 1 awaiting crew change/ 5 vessels due with 1 days delay expected. Port qasim - seven vessels loading at berth (including tco and iocb) (sugar, fuel oil, general cargo, wheat, rice, lpg)/ 5 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (fuel oil, wheat, jute).

SIERRA LEONE, Jan 21 - No labour problems. Two rice dischargers berthed and operating, 1 vessel anchored under arrest. 3 Vessels due of which 1 container discharger, 2 bulk wheat dischargers. For security reasons vessels must endeavour to be in/out of port before 19.00 hrs.

SINGAPORE,- Jan 21 - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 11 Container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 8 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 11 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 3 General cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port - 2 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminals/sbm buoys - 22 Tankers berthed, minimal berthing delays at all terminals/ports/buoys.

SOUTH KOREA, Jan 21 - Inchon - 67 Vessels in port (43 berthed, 24 anchored) of which berthed, 11 general cargo, 4 containers, 4 logs, 3 corn, 3 coils, 3 wheat, 2 steel, 2 h-beams, 2 cars, 1 pig iron, 1 rape seed meal, 1 soya bean meal, 1 cotton seed meal, 1 molasses, 1 pulp, 1 cement, 1 raw sugar, 1 scrap. Vessels anchored, 5 cars, 4 general cargo, containers, 2 steel, 2 logs, 2 ply-wood, 2 coils, 1 palm oil, 1 soya beans, 1 corn, 1 pig-iron, approx. 1-2 days berthing delay expected. Busan - 169 vessels in port (48 berthed, 121 anchored including 60 laid-up) of which berthed, 35 general cargo, 5 containers, 5 scrap, 3 coal. 61 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 2 days delay expected. Po

Ulsan - 26 Vessels in port, all berthed, of which discharging, 3 wood-chips, 2 mono ethyl glycol, 2 crude oil, 1 coal, 1 coke, 1 cement, 1 feed meal, 1 propylene styrene monomer, 1 lead bullion, 1 copper concentrate, 1 pitch coke, 1 corn. Vessels loading, 3 general cargo, 1 cars, 1 resin, 1 acetic acid, 1 base oil, 1 fuel oil, 1 diesel oil, no berthing delays expected. Man - Nine vessels in port, all berthed, of which discharging, 3 steel scrap, 1 steel coils, 1 manganese, 1 pulp, 1 blooms, 1 logs. 1 Cigarette vessel loading, no berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, Jan 21 - Colombo - No labour problems. 15 Vessels loading at berth (12 containers, 3 essential services). 23 Vessels discharging at berth (1 bagged sugar, 12 containers, 1 bulk lpg, 2 steel billets, 1 bulk palm oil, 1 bulk potash, 1 bagged flour, 1 bagged soya meal, 3 general cargo). 2 Vessels waiting at anchor to discharge (1 bulk cement, 1 bulk lpg). 3 Container vessels waiting to discharge/load, 5 vessels bunkering, 2 dry-docked, 7 awaiting orders, 12 due of which 9 containers, 1 bulk gas, 1 bagged rice, 1 bagged flour. 2-3 Days delay expected for conventional vessels. Galle - No vessels operating. Trincomalee - One vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth.

TAIWAN, Jan 18 - Keelung - three vessels anchored, berthing delays - grain - 3 days, coal - 7 days, steel - 4 days, iron ore - 2 days. Kaohsiung - five vessels anchored, berthing delays - grain/steel - 1 day, iron/coal - 4 days (CSC berth), coal,scrap - 2 days (public berth). Taichung - six vessels anchored, berthing delays - grain - 2-3 days, iron ore/coal/scrap/steel/others - 1-2 days. Jan 21 - Kaohsiung - sixty-three vessels in port of which 11 containers, 8 tankers, 2 grain, 3 other bulkers, 30 general cargo, 9 at buoys. 18 vessels waiting at outer anchorage of which 1 grain, 17 general cargo. Berthing delays - 1 day's delay expected for general cargo vessels.THAILAND, Jan 21 - Bangk
